title: get_product_list_pagination_and_filtering
description: Verify that the GET /api/Products endpoint returns a paginated list of products filtered by companyId, categoryId, searchText, and isActive parameters correctly.

title: get_product_by_id_valid_and_invalid
description: Verify that the GET /api/Products/{id} endpoint returns product details for a valid product ID and returns appropriate error for invalid or non-existent product ID.

title: get_product_by_barcode_search
description: Verify that the GET /api/Products/by-barcode endpoint returns the correct product when searched by barcode and companyId, and handles cases where barcode does not exist.

title: check_product_code_existence
description: Verify that the GET /api/Products/check-code endpoint correctly checks if a product code exists for a given companyId and code, excluding a specific product ID if provided.

title: get_next_product_code_generation
description: Verify that the GET /api/Products/next-code endpoint generates the next available product code for a given companyId.

title: generate_unique_barcode
description: Verify that the GET /api/Products/generate-barcode endpoint generates a unique barcode based on the barcodeType and prefix parameters.

title: create_new_product
description: Verify that the POST /api/Products endpoint creates a new product with valid data and returns the created product details.

title: update_existing_product
description: Verify that the PUT /api/Products/{id} endpoint updates an existing product with valid data and returns the updated product details.

title: get_product_stock_level
description: Verify that the GET /api/Products/{id}/stock-level endpoint returns the current stock level for the specified product ID.

title: get_product_stock_movements
description: Verify that the GET /api/Products/{id}/movements endpoint returns the stock movements for the specified product ID.
